name: OmaGTD
author: Enrico Cambiaso
description: Getting Things Done for Omarchy, modelled on OmniFocus. A bar pill that shows the inbox and the next actions, a keyboard-driven panel over what is due today, a fullscreen view for the full five-step GTD workflow — clarify, organize, reflect, engage — and a sqlite3 database underneath. Projects/areas, contexts as tags, waiting, someday/maybe, recurring actions, defer/due forecasting, an internal calendar, and OmniFocus-style review counters. Ships a `gtd` CLI so every step is scriptable and bindable to a hotkey.

barWidget.description: Inbox and next-action counts in the bar; the panel is what is due today.

schema.label: Show the inbox count
schema.description: The number of unprocessed items sitting in the inbox.

schema.label: Show the next-action count
schema.description: How many actions you could do right now. Zero means focus is clear.

schema.label: Glyph only
schema.description: Show the checkmark glyph without any numbers.

schema.label: Hide the counts when nothing is due
schema.description: When nothing has expired and nothing is due today, show just "GTD" instead of "GTD 0/0". A clear day reads as a clear day.

schema.label: Inbox turns urgent at
schema.description: The pill turns red once the inbox holds this many items — the signal to clarify instead of capture.

schema.label: Refresh every (seconds)
schema.description: How often the counts are re-read from the database. Changes made in the panel update immediately.
